title: Release 4.2 after the usual QA pass
transcript:
[00:00] Noor: Release 4.2. Diego, is everything merged?
[00:05] Diego: Everything except the offline drafts fix. That's in review and should land today.
[00:13] Zara: Is offline drafts the one that lost text on Android when you rotated the phone?
[00:19] Diego: That's the one. Turned out to be an activity lifecycle thing.
[00:26] Noor: App store review is taking a day or two lately. When can we submit?
[00:33] Diego: Once the fix lands and it's been through QA.
[00:38] Zara: We'll do the usual QA pass on the release build.
[00:43] Noor: Great. Then let's submit Wednesday if the usual QA pass is clean.
[00:50] Diego: Wednesday works.
[00:52] Zara: OK.
[00:54] Noor: Release notes. Who's writing them?
[00:58] Diego: I'll draft them from the changelog and send them to you.
[01:04] Noor: Thanks. Keep them short, three bullets at most.
[01:09] Zara: Can we mention the rotation fix? A lot of store reviews complained about it.
[01:16] Noor: Yes, lead with that.
[01:19] Diego: Also, the new onboarding screens are behind a flag. They ship dark.
[01:26] Noor: Good. We'll turn them on once the A/B setup is ready.
[01:31] Zara: Then I'll skip onboarding this round.
[01:35] Noor: Agreed. Anything else for 4.2?
[01:39] Diego: The crash reporter upgrade went in last week. Nothing to do, just so you know.
[01:46] Noor: Noted. Thanks, both.
